purpose: Make the user's GitHub-mounted + GPT-chat operating mode explicit without weakening owner-native business semantics or assurance boundaries. Chat mode is executable only when the deterministic transition or lifecycle guard required by the exact action can run in the current session.

activation.when: A publishable Financial Writing action is requested, owner-native runtime is unavailable, and the current session can execute the model work, GitHub owner reads/writes, plus the deterministic GitHub-chat transition/lifecycle guard required by the exact next action.
must_not_activate_when: GitHub owner read/write is unavailable for a material state mutation
financial_writing_agent.github_chat_guard cannot be executed or equivalently evaluated by a deterministic current-session tool
the exact recovery or system-impact action requires financial_writing_agent.github_chat_lifecycle but it cannot be executed or equivalently evaluated by a deterministic current-session tool
the exact stage requires another capability that the current session cannot execute
the user explicitly requests owner-native or independently attested assurance

task_contract.routing_rule: When the user did not explicitly request a platform/mode narrowing, GITHUB_CHAT must call the same canonical routing semantics as OWNER_NATIVE and therefore keep DUAL. A direct distribution-mode override requires USER_EXPLICIT_OVERRIDE plus distribution_mode_override_evidence that is an exact substring of the original user prompt and is persisted in the INIT receipt.
task_contract.adapter_parity_rule: Execution adapters may differ in assurance/executor substrate but may not redefine distribution mode, delivery channel, required outputs, stage graph, revision targets, invalidation, blocked recovery semantics, system-impact lifecycle semantics or terminal semantics.

workflow.adapter_narrowing_rule: GITHUB_CHAT may expose a conservative subset of canonical workflow capabilities because its semantic assurance is weaker, but it may not change the canonical TaskContract or add a stage edge/revision target absent from the Financial owner.
workflow.rule: Use the Financial business sequence from financial_writing_agent.workflow_spec and task/output semantics from TaskContract/routing. Stage advancement/revision/terminalization is accepted only through github_chat_guard against the fetched current main STATE.json blob identity. A review FAIL enters BLOCKED; leaving BLOCKED requires github_chat_lifecycle.resume_blocked_state with explicit repair evidence and invalidation of the failed review artifact/decision before the same review stage is retried.

checkpoint_contract.mutation_guard: Fetch main/workspaces/articles/{task_id}/STATE.json and its current blob SHA, run the exact deterministic Financial guard required by the action (github_chat_guard for normal transitions/feedback; github_chat_lifecycle for BLOCKED recovery or system-impact review/closure), then replace that same main file using the same SHA. A stale blob, non-main state ref or guard failure blocks the mutation.
checkpoint_contract.blocked_recovery: A BLOCKED review task resumes only through github_chat_lifecycle.resume_blocked_state with non-empty repair evidence. Recovery stays on the exact blocked review stage, requires the persisted failed review artifact/decision, invalidates both, and requires a fresh review artifact before guarded advancement.
checkpoint_contract.execution_receipt_rule: Every material chat-mode state mutation appends one self-attested execution receipt containing task/stage/capability/action, executor identity, main state_ref, prior state blob SHA, subject/input bindings, task/output contract bindings where applicable, output refs and result. INIT additionally records exact user-prompt evidence for any explicit single-mode override. Receipt existence does not make the chat independent or owner-native.
checkpoint_contract.post_write_verification: Reread STATE.json and every newly referenced stage artifact from main after the GitHub mutation; a guard PASS or GitHub tool success alone is not commit proof.
checkpoint_contract.stage_artifact_identity: Git main repository path + blob SHA
checkpoint_contract.article_source_identity: Git main repository path + blob SHA or content digest

stage_evidence.RESEARCH: Persist a structured research artifact covering the canonical Research contract: evidence ledger, source boundary, coverage sweeps, Universe Coverage where applicable, counterevidence, uncertainty and Market Explanation scope.
stage_evidence.RESEARCH_AUDIT: Persist a separate red-team review artifact. In one GPT chat its assurance is CHAT_SELF_REVIEW; it may force REVISE or FAIL but must not be represented as owner-native or independent PASS.
stage_evidence.EDITORIAL: Persist TopicDNA, at least two topic-specific candidate structures per applicable mode, selected structure, completeness/company obligations and comparison map where applicable. Applicable modes come from the immutable task contract.
stage_evidence.TITLE: Persist the 8-12 candidate pool per applicable mode, angle-family diversity, selected title and current search evidence.
stage_evidence.DRAFT: Persist the complete structured publication source for every applicable mode before any delivery artifact is created.
stage_evidence.EDITORIAL_AUDIT: Persist Reader Funnel, Authorial Prose/template, and general editorial self-review separately. CHAT_SELF_REVIEW may revise or fail the draft; it is not proof-bearing independent certification.
stage_evidence.DELIVERY: Generate Word from the persisted publication source using current document tooling. Before DELIVERY can advance, github_chat_guard must reconcile the structured article delivery manifest against TaskContract.required_outputs minus AUDIT_DOCX. For default DUAL this means both FINANCE_DEEP_DOCX and FINANCE_BROAD_DOCX must exist with file name + SHA256.
stage_evidence.MECHANICAL_AUDIT: Persist the checks actually executed and their result for every required article Word output. PASS may advance only while the article delivery manifest still exactly satisfies the task contract; unavailable render/file checks stay OPEN.
stage_evidence.FINAL_AUDIT: Persist a final red-team artifact against frozen GitHub source + delivery evidence. Before terminalization, github_chat_guard must reconcile the complete required-output set, including AUDIT_DOCX. PASS remains DELIVERED_CHAT_REVIEWED__CERTIFICATION_OPEN unless stronger execution evidence separately exists.

assurance.terminal_claim_rule: A useful article may be delivered after the full guard-enforced GitHub-chat workflow and self-review path completes, but owner-native/independent certification remains OPEN. Never translate CHAT_REVIEWED, lifecycle evidence binding, or a self-attested chat execution receipt into the Python GateStatus PASS proof model.

learning_and_maintenance.material_user_edit_feedback_rejection: Use github_chat_guard.attach_material_feedback so material negative/corrective evidence and its OPEN system-impact item are written into the same guarded STATE.json mutation and exact action-bound receipt before the learning loop is called closed.
learning_and_maintenance.system_impact_lifecycle: Use github_chat_lifecycle.review_system_impact_state to classify each OPEN item as LOCAL_ONLY, SYSTEM_MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED or NO_CHANGE_WITH_REASON. SYSTEM_MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED stays open until an exact replay of the accepted diagnosis binds maintenance_ref + validation_refs whose evidence assurance is labeled at least REGRESSION_VERIFIED. The lifecycle guard records this as SELF_ATTESTED_CHAT_EVIDENCE_BINDING, not independent verification, and moves the closed item to system_impact_history instead of erasing it.
learning_and_maintenance.shared_method_propagation: Use current Universal operational_hygiene/evolution method; keep Financial business truth local. A maintenance change is not closed until its impact map includes startup/Skill, canonical policy/reference, runtime adapters, deterministic harness/evals, mirrors and stale/legacy surfaces that consume the changed invariant.

failure_behavior.missing_transition_guard: BLOCK the stage transition; do not hand-edit STATE.json or continue as if the SOP was enforced.
failure_behavior.missing_lifecycle_guard: BLOCK BLOCKED-recovery or system-impact lifecycle mutation; do not hand-edit STATE.json to clear a blocker or maintenance obligation.
failure_behavior.missing_github_write: BLOCK exact material mutation; do not continue as if state were durable.
failure_behavior.non_main_business_state_ref: BLOCK the material mutation. Per-article branches are not a current GITHUB_CHAT business-state authority.
failure_behavior.missing_or_narrowed_task_contract: BLOCK. When no explicit user narrowing exists, default routing is DUAL and cannot be silently changed by the chat executor.
failure_behavior.unverified_single_mode_override: BLOCK. A single-mode override requires exact user-prompt substring evidence in the INIT receipt; a model-authored provenance label alone is insufficient.
failure_behavior.missing_required_article_output: BLOCK DELIVERY advancement; do not compensate with a prose claim or audit note.
failure_behavior.missing_audit_output: BLOCK FINAL terminalization; AUDIT_DOCX remains a required output.
failure_behavior.missing_web_for_current_fact_research: BLOCK or explicitly bound the research scope; do not invent current evidence.
failure_behavior.missing_document_tooling: Keep publication source complete in GitHub and mark DOCX delivery OPEN; do not claim Word contract satisfied.
failure_behavior.missing_independent_or_owner_native_audi: Continue only at CHAT_SELF_REVIEW assurance and keep certification OPEN; do not fabricate PASS.
failure_behavior.context_or_connection_loss: Resume from main STATE.json + exact stage artifact refs + execution receipts, not remembered prose.

anti_bypass: No publishable final article is produced directly from INTAKE without a guarded GitHub task checkpoint.
No chat executor may silently change the canonical distribution mode or required-output set.
No single-mode override is accepted solely because the chat labels it USER_EXPLICIT_OVERRIDE; exact user-prompt evidence is mandatory.
No Research/Editorial/Title/Draft stage is treated as completed without a durable artifact ref.
No DELIVERY advancement is accepted with a missing applicable article Word output.
No FINAL terminalization is accepted until the complete TaskContract.required_outputs set is present in the structured delivery manifest.
No current_stage change, review route or terminalization is accepted without github_chat_guard validation and one new action-bound execution receipt.

No BLOCKED task is resumed by manual state surgery; exact-stage recovery requires repair evidence, the persisted failed review evidence, invalidation of that failed evidence, and a fresh retry artifact.
No OPEN or MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED system-impact item is removed by manual state surgery; classification and closure use the deterministic lifecycle guard and retain history.
No GITHUB_CHAT lifecycle evidence binding is relabeled as independent verification or owner-native proof.
No GITHUB_CHAT business state is newly written to an article branch; main/workspaces/articles/{task_id} is the only write surface.
No chat self-review is relabeled as INDEPENDENT_EXECUTOR or owner-runtime PASS.
No missing owner runtime is silently replaced by free-form writing; the explicit guard-enforced GitHub-chat adapter is the only chat fallback.
No Site/MCP deployment is required merely to use this adapter.
